# DVSA Slot Notifier

> A free WhatsApp community that posts a message whenever a new UK driving test slot becomes available, labelled by postcode, with the slot date and time.

DVSA Slot Notifier is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the DVSA or GOV.UK.

## How it works
- Visitors click "Join the WhatsApp group" and are taken to a short questionnaire hosted on watomod.com, a WhatsApp community moderator tool.
- A moderator reviews the answers and approves entry to the group.
- Approved members receive alerts in WhatsApp when a slot opens in a postcode, e.g. "New slot available: M8 8EP, Tue 3 Nov, 13:10".

## Pages
- [Home](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/): overview, live-style alert preview, join link, and a table of the latest slot discovered in five sample postcodes (refreshed nightly).
- [Latest slots data](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/data/latest-slots.json): JSON used by the table; updated nightly.

## Notes
- Slot times are shown by postcode, not place name. Data on the page is currently sample data.
- Booking is done by the user on the official GOV.UK service; this project does not book tests.
